items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one exquisitely ornate HIGH FANTASY mythic ARMOR inventory illustration, square canvas. This is the prestigious successor ABOVE the Emperor armor in reference image 1. The user now explicitly wants an extravagant fantasy design. Completely reinvent the armor rather than recoloring the reference.
INPUT ROLES: image 1 = existing lower-tier Emperor armor, use only as a baseline of finish, clarity and grandeur to SURPASS. Do not copy its breastplate, sun reactor or crown shoulders. Image 2 = the user's color/light swatch, deep teal with radiant emerald-turquoise green flashes. Preserve this luminous jewel color rather than the red of image 1.

SUBJECT: one empty divine imperial cuirass with both pauldrons, raised collar and fitted waist. No body, head, helmet, arms or legs. Three-quarter front product view. Proud broad silhouette, strong sculptural chest, graceful tapered lower armor.
NEW DESIGN: a breathtaking celestial sovereign's regalia. Massive fan-shaped pauldrons formed from three interlocking sculpted platinum-gold wing plates per side; each plate has intricate curling chased gold relief, an emerald inlay and a clean pointed edge. Architectural openwork shoulder crests instead of simple spikes. High scalloped ivory-gold collar with dark emerald velvet lining. The breastplate is luminous polished platinum enamel with deeply carved gold arabesques arranged around a huge elongated pear-cut emerald suspended within a sculptural gold radiating reliquary. The gem emits emerald-white fire and a few delicate arcs of magical light. Curving gold ribs sweep downward into overlapping engraved waist plates; rich dark teal velvet visible only in narrow layered recesses. Two short emerald satin shoulder drapes add regal richness without hiding armor. Jewelry-grade gold detail and substantial silver-gold armor volumes, elaborate beauty at every scale. A fine luminous arcane aureole behind the collar makes its ascended tier unmistakable. This should look like a god-emperor's legendary treasure, gloriously ornate and expensive, substantially grander than reference 1.

FRAME: an elaborate SQUARE treasure frame on all four edges. Thick dimensional champagne-gold and platinum molding, intricately carved acanthus scrollwork, four grand emerald-set corner ornaments, small sovereign crown ornament centered at top and a sculpted small jeweled clasp at bottom. Clean square outer silhouette, every corner entirely inside canvas with tiny outer margin. Frame must be visibly decorated like an actual luxury frame, not plain border lines. No blank nameplate. Leave breathing space between armor and inner edge.

PALETTE AND LIGHT: bright platinum, warm royal gold, deep teal-green shadow and rich emerald-turquoise gems with white-green highlights, matching image 2. Saturated elegant color, no blue/red gems, no yellow-lime. Dark emerald celestial mist behind it, magical sparks and soft luminous rays. Armor remains brilliant and readable, never a dark flat lump.
FINISH: masterful high-end 2D fantasy game item painting, crisp silhouettes, precise ornamental details, jewel refraction and polished gold reflections, dramatic richly lit high rarity loot icon. Lavish sculptural fantasy, not machinery.
CONSTRAINTS: single full armor, one square frame, entire item visible, no collage, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark. No mechanical panels, no reactors, no circuit boards, no screws, no floating rectangular plates, no science-fiction robot parts. Do not merely paint the Emperor green; the silhouette, ornament system and centerpiece must be new.
